capabilities: Render gnuplot code blocks as plots in place
Plot data from CSV, DAT or TXT files in the vault, redrawing on changes
Flip each plot between the rendered image and its source code
Support functions, inline data, splot and multiplots with captions and alt text
Adapt plot colors to dark and light themes
extras: Desktop only. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Ships gnuplot built in, works offline, and documents limits (64,000-character blocks, 1 MB per data file, 16 files / 4 MB per plot).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render gnuplot code blocks as plots, so functions and data in notes can't be visualized without external tools.

relations.evidence: Plots are drawn by gnuplot. The licenses of the software built into this plugin are listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

summary: Code-block renderer that draws gnuplot plots in Reading view and Live Preview, including plots of CSV, DAT or TXT files in the vault.
